about: Kelowna is the largest city in B.C.’s Okanagan Valley, on the eastern shore of Okanagan Lake. It is a service, tourism, and wine-industry centre in a dry interior climate. Bridges connect to West Kelowna; orchards and vineyards still occupy the benches above the lake. About 145,000 people live in Kelowna.
seoSummary: Largest Okanagan city, a lake, wine, and interior service centre.
